en.headline: Worker falls three metres from water tank at Tai Kok Tsui estate
en.dek: A 60-year-old man was found unconscious after an apparent fall during maintenance work at Imperial Cullinan on Hoi Fai Road; police are treating it as an industrial accident.
body: A 60-year-old male worker was taken to hospital unconscious on Thursday evening after falling about three metres from a water tank at the Imperial Cullinan private residential estate in Tai Kok Tsui.

Police said the incident was reported at about 7.19pm inside the estate at 10 Hoi Fai Road. The man appeared to have fallen while carrying out maintenance work and was found unconscious. Paramedics treated him at the scene before conveying him to hospital for emergency care.
Officers classified the case as an industrial accident and are investigating the cause. No further details on the man’s condition were immediately available.

zh.headline: 大角咀帝匯豪庭維修工人墮水箱三米昏迷
zh.dek: 60歲男工人周四傍晚在海輝道私人屋苑進行維修時疑由約三米高水箱墮下，昏迷送院，警方列工業意外調查。
body: 大角咀海輝道10號帝匯豪庭私人屋苑周四傍晚發生工業意外，一名60歲男工人疑在進行維修期間由約三米高的水箱墮下，昏迷送院。
警方表示，約晚上7時19分接報意外，男子被發現昏迷，救護員到場救治後送院接受緊急治療。
案件暫列工業意外，警方正調查意外原因，男子傷勢詳情暫未有公布。
